compliance_risks.could_misstate: Describing any of these as insurance. Describing a discount program as insurance is a material misrepresentation. Six are named as discount programs; the rest are simply unknown, including products whose names sound insured such as AD&D, Critical Care, Term Life and Fusion Dental.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe AssistPro, GapSupport, Ameriguard, Prime Health Pass, Express Health Tools or HealthAssist as insurance or as coverage - the portal names each of them a Discount. Do not describe the remaining 36 at all until typed. Do not say 'PPO' about Allstate Dental PPO in a way implying major medical.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing product-specific. An add-on should not be described until its type is established.

source.sec: NEO product list; registry entries with product_type NEEDS_MANUAL_VERIFICATION

compliance_risks.verified_fact: 43 add-on products are listed on the NEO platform. NONE has a document in Drive. 36 of them could not be assigned a product type from any available source. Six are typed as discount programs solely because the portal's own product name contains the word 'Discount'.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before mentioning any add-on by name on a recorded call.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: The monthly cost quoted on a recorded call must include this fee, or the fee must be stated separately before the payment authorisation. Quoting the product page price alone understates what the client will be charged.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A 3.5% credit-card or ACH processing fee applies to every payment and appears only in the platform TERMS panel, which more than half the product pages do not display at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client a scheduled benefit amount will be paid in full without qualifying it by the URC limit.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A platform-level usual, reasonable and customary cap applies on top of every product's stated benefits and appears only in the TERMS panel.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every recorded verification must cover all four elements. Omitting the recurring monthly amount or the automatic draft is a breach of the platform agreement, not only a compliance risk.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The platform agreement requires an electronic signature or a recorded verification script with every sale, and specifies the four things the member must be shown to understand: the product, its benefits, the initial payment, and the recurring monthly amount drafted automatically.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose to any client on a tight account that a single failed draft can end the plan.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A dishonoured payment can result in forfeiture of the plan with no liability on anyone's part, expressly including where the dishonour was inadvertent or without cause.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never describe NEO as the insurance company. Name the carrier for the specific product.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Neo Insurance Solutions is an agency and platform, not the insurer, and disclaims liability for agents' conduct and representations.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose the 3.5% card/ACH processing fee on every sale regardless of which page the client was shown. Do not rely on the panel a given product page happens to display.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The storefront serves two different versions of the NEO enrolment agreement. The shorter one, on the MDLive pages, omits the 3.5% processing fee, the contact and electronic-document consents, the HIPAA statement and the member signature block.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client they can spend the full dental maximum on eyewear. Vision is capped at $100 a year on both plans.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The page markets a single shared Fusion maximum, then states that dental and vision sub-limits still apply and that vision is capped at $100 regardless.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Explain the pay-first-claim-later mechanism. A client expecting to hand over a card at the optician will be surprised.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The vision benefit requires the member to pay the eye doctor first and submit a claim form and receipt for reimbursement, up to $100 a year.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Present as discounts, not as benefits, and do not promise availability at a particular store.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The eyewear and prescription savings are discount programmes at named retailers, separate from the insured benefits and varying by location.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client 'the terms are on the page'. Establish which agreement governs their enrolment, and disclose the 3.5% processing fee regardless of which panel their product displays.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Four different NEO enrolment agreements are in simultaneous circulation on the storefront, and most product pages show none at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any Plan B client, quote coverage from the brochure's Plan B column, never from the NEO page. Saying X-rays are covered at 100% or a root canal at 80% on Plan B is a benefit misstatement.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: On Plan B the brochure puts all X-rays in Type 2 Basic (80%) rather than Type 1 Preventive (100%), and all endodontics - including nonsurgical root canals - in Type 3 Major (50%) rather than Basic. The NEO product page shows one combined list that matches Plan A only.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: When Dental Rewards are used as a selling point, state the use-it-or-lose-it condition: one claim per year is required to keep the accumulated bank.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: If no dental claim is submitted in a year, accumulated Dental Rewards are lost entirely - not merely paused.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Present both as discounts. Note the brochure extends the Rx discount to pets, which underlines that it is a retail programme rather than a benefit.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The Walmart/Sam's Club Rx discount is expressly not insurance, and the eyewear saving is a retail discount.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Pass this on rather than estimating a member's share on the call - particularly on Plan A, where the MCE schedule is not available to anyone.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The brochure itself recommends a pretreatment estimate for any service over $200.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every 'is X covered' question for this product must go to Ameritas or the certificate. There is currently nothing to answer it from.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Neither the eleven-page brochure nor the portal page carries a limitations or exclusions section for NCE Fusion.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never quote $250 a year in rewards. The plan's own figures are in a highlight sheet nobody in this project has.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The Dental Rewards worked example uses a $500 threshold, $250 annual reward and $1,000 annual maximum, and the page states these are an example only.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not present rewards as extra money available at any time. They come into play only once the annual maximum is used up, and the client still pays their coinsurance share.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Accumulated rewards are applied to covered dental services only after the dental annual maximum has been exceeded, and remain subject to deductible, coinsurance and plan provisions.

open_gaps.what_is_unknown: Documentation for 43 add-on products. Not one has a document in Drive; several link brochures on NEO's own media host that are behind the login wall.
Every product Info page and Cost page on both platforms; roughly 110 pages in total.
All TalentLMS course content.

Not a missing document - a method finding. The Benefit Summary tables in the Smart Choice documents contain overlapping text runs that cause ordinary text extraction to assign cost-sharing figures to the WRONG ROWS.
Current product lists. Both list snapshots are dated 2026-04-08, five months old.

TalentLMS course interiors. The catalogue was inventoried - 82 courses across ASG Onboarding (61), Product (11) and General (10) - and one course detail panel was read. Course units could not be opened without clicking 'Get this course', which would enrol the user.

addon.dental_health_report_card.v: After 12 months of using the dental benefit, Ameritas provides a dental health report card developed with the University of Nebraska Medical Center College of Dentistry

addon.discounts.premium_effect.v: The prescription and eyewear discounts are not insurance and are at no additional cost to the plan premium

addon.eyewear_discount.v: Up to 15% off frames and lenses at Walmart Vision Centers nationwide

addon.eyewear_savings.v: Up to 15% off eyewear frames and lenses at any Walmart Vision Center nationwide; members may bring a current vision prescription from any provider

addon.ihear.v: iHear at-home hearing test, programming kit, devices and accessories ordered online; expressly not insurance

addon.prescription_savings.figures.v: Illustration shows a name-brand prescription reduced from $25 and a generic at $11; the footnote states up to 65% savings on generic prescriptions and overall average savings of 40% across brand name and generic prescriptions combined, based on Lexapro TAB 20MG and Escitalopram TAB 20MG, ZIP 68510

addon.prescription_savings_card.v: Ameritas/EnvisionSavings prescription drug savings card - RxBin 017529, Group AMERITAS, Member ID AMER2233, PCN AMRX - accepted at over 60,000 pharmacies including CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid and Walmart; pharmacy and member help desk 1-877-684-0032

addon.rx_discount.v: Savings at Walmart and Sam's Club pharmacies, including low-cost generics and discounts on other medications

addon.rx_savings.v: Walmart and Sam's Club pharmacy discount at no additional cost, available to covered dependents and their pets: hundreds of generics at $4.00, approximately 40% off all other generics, 10-15% off most brand-name prescriptions, plus mail order

addon.vision_reimbursement.v: Ameritas Vision Perfect Eye Care: members may visit any eye doctor, pay for services, then submit a claim form and receipt for reimbursement, up to $100 per year

addon.worldwide_support.v: AXA Assistance provides dental and vision provider referrals and appointment coordination outside the U.S., with offices in more than 30 countries, 24 hours a day

benefit.combined_deductible.v: Dental and vision deductibles may be combined; the deductible may be satisfied by a combination of dental and vision services up to the individual plan limits, with a ceiling of the FUSION deductible

benefit.deductible_coordination.v: Dental and vision deductibles may be combined to help reduce total out-of-pocket costs, within plan rules

benefit.dental_rewards.v: Unused dental benefit carryover: earn by submitting at least one dental claim in a year and staying at or below the annual threshold; accumulated rewards are kept even if a future year exceeds the threshold; rewards are lost only if no dental claim is submitted during a year, after which earning restarts the next year

benefit.dental_rewards.accounts.v: The member and each covered dependent have their own separate rewards accounts

benefit.dental_rewards.application.v: Accumulated rewards may be applied to covered dental services after exceeding the dental annual maximum benefit, and are subject to the applicable deductible, coinsurance and plan provisions

benefit.dental_rewards.mechanics.v: Members qualify by submitting at least one claim each year and keeping total benefits received for that year at or below the plan's annual threshold amount. If no dental claims are submitted during a year, no rewards are earned and accumulated rewards are LOST. If a member does visit the dentist but exceeds the annual threshold, they earn no reward for that year but keep their accumulated rewards. Benefit status is checkable online

benefit.maximum_ceiling.v: No more than the noted dental maximum may be applied to dental benefits and no more than the noted vision maximum to vision benefits, with a ceiling of the FUSION maximum for both

benefit.maximum_structure.v: One combined Fusion annual maximum across dental and vision, with separate dental and vision sub-limits still applying

benefit.mce_definition.v: Maximum Covered Expense is the maximum amount considered per procedure

benefit.ppo_bonus.v: Using a participating dental network provider may earn an additional PPO Bonus carryover amount

benefit.vision_reimbursement.v: Vision Perfect members select any eye doctor, pay the doctor for all services, then submit a claim form and receipt to Ameritas Group for reimbursement

claims.contact.v: group@ameritas.com; 800-487-5553; Monday-Thursday 7 a.m. to midnight CST, Friday 7 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. CST; Spanish-speaking representatives and telephone interpretation available

claims.performance.v: Ameritas states 99.39% of phone calls answered within 15 seconds, 99% claims processing accuracy, and claims processed in an average of 9 business days

claims.pretreatment_estimate.v: For services over $200 the brochure recommends asking the dentist to request a pretreatment estimate; the member receives a written response showing what Ameritas estimates the plan will pay and the member's share

covered.type_1_preventive.v: Routine exam; cleaning; bitewing X-rays; full mouth or panoramic X-rays; periapical X-rays; fluoride for children age 13 and under

covered.type_2_basic.v: Sealants; restorative amalgams and composites; endodontics as listed in the brochure; denture repair; simple extractions

covered.type_3_major.v: Crowns and crown repair; onlays; periodontics, non-surgical and surgical; prosthodontics including bridges and dentures; complex extractions; space maintainers; endodontics including surgical where applicable; anesthesia

form_code.v: NCE FUSION: THE ULTIMATE CHOICE DENTAL INSURANCE 2.15v5

marketing_and_underwriting.v: Marketed by NCE, underwritten by Ameritas

network.access_points.v: Over 319,000 provider access points for dental care nationwide

network.credentialing.v: Network providers must meet Ameritas credentialing and quality assurance requirements

network.freedom.v: Members may see any dentist, in or out of network; family members do not need to see the same dentist

network.mexico.v: The Ameritas Dental Network extends to Mexico: members may visit dental providers in Mexico and still receive coverage, with discounted fees and agreements honoured by AmexUS Mexico providers and claims processed by Ameritas

network.nominate.v: A member whose dentist is not in the network can nominate them via ameritas.com

network.restrictions.v: No network restrictions; members may use any dentist or eye doctor, though PPO dentists can reduce out-of-pocket costs through discounted fees

network.savings.v: Dentists in the Ameritas network have agreed to charge 25-50% less than their regular rates; many also offer discounted fees on non-covered dental services as allowed by state law
